params.prompt:
Vertical 9:16 paid-social ad, 1080x1920. Copy the reference image's exact text layout: the StoreHub wordmark in the top-right corner set comfortably below the very top edge; the white headline block sitting across the middle of the frame; a small cream sub-line beneath it; then a rounded bright orange #ff9419 pill button with near-black bold label and small light-grey price text to its right; and the lower quarter of the frame left as photograph only, completely free of text. Style: photographic documentary background, bold condensed sans-serif headline in white (Barlow Black style), soft dark gradient behind the lower text so it stays legible. Wordmark reads exactly StoreHub, Store in orange #ff9419 and Hub in white. TEXT ACCURACY IS CRITICAL: reproduce each quoted string word-for-word, never repeat or drop a word. Render ONLY the quoted strings — never render these layout instructions, never render any percentage figures, measurements, labels or annotations. No watermarks, no sparkle marks, no other logos. Currency always Malaysian ringgit written as RM, never a dollar sign. Southeast Asian (Malaysian) faces only, upmarket modern venue, warm natural light.

SCENE: Macro shot of a thermal receipt curling mid-print out of a clean modern receipt printer on a bright cafe counter, shallow depth of field, a Malaysian barista softly blurred behind, warm daylight, upmarket fit-out. Receipt lines show ringgit amounts written as RM.

HEADLINE (largest text, left aligned, 3 lines): "Every sale recorded. E-Invoice ready before you lock up."
SUB-LINE (small, cream): "From first order to closing report."
PILL BUTTON LABEL (all caps): "WATCH IT PRINT"
PRICE TEXT BESIDE PILL: "From RM3.40/day"
